scripts.build: npm run build -w @possible/catalog && npm run build:consumers && node scripts/prepare-sites-dist.mjs
scripts.build:consumers: npm run build -w @fraylabs/possible && npm run build -w @possible/mcp && npm run build -w @possible/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @possible/catalog && npm run test -w @fraylabs/possible && npm run test -w @possible/mcp && npm run test -w @possible/web
scripts.db:lint: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/run-supabase.mjs db lint --linked --schema public --level warning --fail-on error
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run skill:validate && npm run routes:validate && npm run test && npm run build:consumers && npm run html:validate
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @possible/catalog && npm run dev -w @possible/web
